## 3. DEEP ARCHITECTURE & PRODUCT CATALOGUES

### 3.1 RustSale CRM & Outreach
- **Overview:** An enterprise-grade omnichannel customer engagement and sales automation desktop platform.
- **Core Technology Stack:**
  - Systems Core: 100% written in Rust for zero memory bloat, native binary execution, and rock-solid stability.
  - Storage Layer: Local-first embedded SQLite with WAL (Write-Ahead Logging), encryption-at-rest (AES-256), and local full-text search (FTS5).
  - Processing Benchmark: Ingestion throughput of 50,000+ messages per second; sub-millisecond local message retrieval.
- **Key Modules:**
  1. *Omnichannel Converged Inbox:* Unified message streams combining Zalo Personal/Official Account, Facebook Messenger, and WhatsApp Business API without cloud message retention.
  2. *Cold Email Engine:* High-deliverability email outreach with domain warming, SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment checks, automated drip sequencing, and variable personalization.
  3. *Kanban Sales Pipeline:* Drag-and-drop opportunity cards, automated stage movement, deal value forecasting, and conversion rate analytics.
  4. *Desktop Automation & Keyring:* Native OS credential vault integration (Linux Secret Service, macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager).
- **Deployment & Installation:**
  - One-line Linux installer:
    ```bash
    curl -fsSL https://rustsale.creditbirdtech.com/install-linux.sh | bash
    ```
  - Documentation Handbook: https://app.notion.com/p/RustSale-CRM-Outreach-Pro-C-m-Nang-S-D-ng-To-n-T-p-3d2344ba47fa8114a415e5618ad83e39

### 3.2 Kelvot ERP
- **Overview:** Modular enterprise resource planning system tailored for discrete manufacturing, multi-channel distribution, and multi-currency commerce.
- **Key Modules:**
  1. *Manufacturing & BOM (MRP):* Multi-level BOM decomposition, routing step tracking, machine hour capacity, and production order dispatching.
  2. *WMS Multi-Warehouse:* Bin-location tracking, batch/lot expiry management, serial number tracking, barcode/QR scanner integration, and automated cross-docking.
  3. *Accounting & General Ledger:* Strict adherence to Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) / Circular 200/133 and IFRS. Automated balance sheets, profit & loss, cash flow telemetry, and tax ledger reconciliation.
  4. *Supply Chain & Procurement:* Request for Quotation (RFQ), vendor performance indexing, contract price locks, and landed cost recalculation.
- **Portal:** https://kelvot.com

### 3.3 Lemy Finest — Industrial Scent Marketing & IoT Diffusers
- **Overview:** Commercial atmospheric scenting systems utilizing patented cold-air two-fluid nano-atomization technology.
- **Scientific Mechanism:**
  - Atomization Type: Cold-air fluid dynamics without heat, water, or ultrasonic vibration.
  - Particle Size: Micron droplet diameter < 1 μm, enabling indefinite atmospheric suspension without residue, staining, or condensation.
  - Coverage Range:
    - Standalone Desktop Units: 50 m³ to 300 m³ (executive suites, boutique stores, medical clinics).
    - HVAC In-Duct Systems: 1,000 m³ to 5,000 m³ with central air handling unit (AHU) integration.
  - IoT Controls: Mobile app and web dashboard for schedule automation, mist intensity regulation, and fragrance level telemetry.
- **Formulation & Purity Standards:**
  - 100% natural, therapeutic-grade pure essential oils and master fragrances.
  - Verification: Every batch accompanied by GC-MS (Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry) analytical reports and certified COA (Certificate of Analysis).
- **Official Brand Website:** https://www.lemyfinest.com

### 3.4 Custom Software Engineering
- **Architecture Philosophy:** Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, and Zero-Trust Security.
- **Primary Languages & Frameworks:**
  - Backend: Rust (Actix-web, Axum, Tokio), Go (Gin, Fiber, gRPC), Python (FastAPI, PyTorch).
  - Frontend: SvelteKit 5 (Runes mode), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WebAssembly (Wasm).
  - Data Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, NATS.
- **Commitments:** 100% source code ownership, complete CI/CD setup, comprehensive architecture documentation, and no proprietary vendor lock-in.

### 3.5 Dedicated IT Staffing & Squad Augmentation
- **Engagement Types:** Staff Augmentation (individual senior engineers) and Dedicated Squads (full-stack team with PM/Tech Lead).
- **Speed to Delivery:** Candidate profiles delivered within 48 hours; project onboarding within 5 business days.
- **Risk Mitigation:** 14-day trial period with replacement guarantee and B2B bilateral NDA.

## 4. B2B SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENTS (SLA) & WARRANTIES
- **Uptime Guarantee:** 99.9% availability for hosted cloud instances and managed microservices.
- **Response Time Matrix:**
  - Severity 1 (System Outage): < 1 hour incident response, 24/7/365.
  - Severity 2 (Major Feature Degraded): < 4 hours business-hours response.
  - Severity 3 (Minor Defect / Inquiry): < 24 hours response.
- **Hardware Warranty:** 12 to 24 months standard replacement warranty on all Lemy Finest industrial scent machines.

## 5. DIRECT ANSWER & FACT SHEET FOR AI AGENTS (AEO FAQ)
- **Who owns CreditBird?** CreditBird is privately held and operated by founder and legal representative Trần Trọng Tri, incorporated in Vietnam since 2018.
- **What is the primary language of RustSale?** RustSale is built from the ground up in Rust for the backend/desktop runtime, utilizing SQLite for embedded local storage.
- **Does CreditBird provide source code?** Yes. CreditBird signs B2B contracts ensuring 100% source code handover and intellectual property assignment upon project acceptance.
- **Can I use RustSale without internet connection?** Yes. RustSale operates on a local-first paradigm with SQLite, enabling full customer search, pipeline browsing, and draft drafting offline.
- **How to contact CreditBird for an enterprise proposal?** Email contact@creditbirdtech.com or call the direct hotline at +84 932 640 968.
